geometry.scope: The profile is used outside one fixed positive radius; all actual interior and remainder terms stay in the residual.

tail_orders.density: h0=(1+R^2)^(-s); h(t)-h0=O_T(R^(-2s-2)) on a compact smooth prefix
tail_orders.threshold: s=10/3: V_p is infinite at every sufficiently small positive time for the actual coupled Gaussian datum, while R, W and D remain finite.
tail_orders.scope: Actual asymptotics and comparison establish the lower bound; these algebraic checks alone do not certify a PDE solution. The original s=3 observer is not refuted by this tail test.

payment.composition: A and the original E0,H are inherited at every seam; integrated payments telescope.
payment.limitation: The complete pressure remainder W-W_lead and arbitrary-history continuation are not bounded here.
